Request a Demo Privacy Policy 1. Subject matter of this privacy statement ​ We appreciate your interest in our website and our offers on our websites (hereafter referred to as “justclaims”) ​ Our main aim is the protection of your personal data (hereafter referred to as “data”). In the following we would like to inform you in detail about what data are collected during your visit to our website and the use of our offers and how we process or use the data hereafter, as well as which accompanying protective measures we have taken in technical and organizational terms. ​ 2. Responsible body/ service provider ​ Responsible body in terms of the Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) and at the same time service provider in terms of the Telemedia Act (TMG) is ​ CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH Güterplatz 1 60327 Frankfurt am Main T +49 69 380 299 910 E info@claims-handling.com ​ Managing directors: Ulrich Steppler Katja H. Brecke ​ The CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH is registered in the commercial register of the Frankfurt am Main Local Court under HRB 108923. ​ If you have any questions or comments about this privacy statement or about data protection in general, please send them to the following e-mail address info@claims-handling.com . ​ 3. Collection and use of data ​ At the moment you can only use our website for informational purposes. For the in-formational use of our website, it is not necessary for you to provide data. In this case, we only collect and use the data that your internet browser automatically transmits to us, such as for example: ​ date and time of access to one of our websites our browser type the browser settings the operated system used your last visited page the amount of data transferred and the access status (file transferred, file not found, etc.) as well as your IP-address. ​ We collect and use this data during an informational visit exclusively in a non-personalized form. This is done in order to enable the use of the websites you have accessed, for statistic purposes and to improve our internet offer. The IP-address is only stored for the duration of your visit, no person-related analysis takes place. ​ 4. Use of cookies ​ We use the technology of cookies for our website. Cookies are small text files that are sent to your browser by our web server during your visit to our website, who stores it on your computer for later retrieval. ​ We only use so-called session cookies (also referred to as temporary cookies), i.e. those that are only stored temporarily for the duration of your use of one of our web-sites. The purpose of those cookies is the continuous identification of your computer during your visit to one of our websites and the switch to another of our websites and to ascertain the end of your visit. ​ The cookies are deleted as soon as you end your browser session. ​ Whether cookies can be set and retrieved can be determined by the settings in your browser. For example, you can completely deactivate the storage of cookies in your browser, restrict it to certain web pages or configure your browser in such a way that it automatically notifies you, as soon as a cookie is to be set and asks you for a response. However, for technical reasons, it is necessary to allow session cookies on behalf of the functionality of our website. ​ We do not collect or store personal data in cookies in this context. ​ 5. Data security ​ We also use technical and organizational security measures to protect the incoming or collected personal data, in particular against accidental or intentional manipulation, loss, destruction or against the attack of unauthorized persons. Our security measures are continuously improved in line with technological developments. Request a Demo justclaims.eu - About us Who is justclaims.eu? ​ justclaims.eu was founded by a team of aviation attorneys in order to offer airline clients an easy and encompassing tool for their claims handling. With the number of air passenger claims skyrocketing, claim agencies gaining the upper hand and IATA forecasting the doubling of passenger demand until 2038, the time-consuming handling of endless spreadsheets or clunky CRM systems will have no future. ​ justclaims.eu provides a digital end-to-end alternative to save time and to lower costs . With a high degree of automation, efficient internal and external communication, payment solutions, and detailed analytics and reporting, the claims handling process can be centralized and significantly simplified. ​ The platform enables airlines to improve response times to passengers , enhance quality, balance out fluctuations, and thus promote customer loyalty. A network of highly specialized aviation law firms supports the process or defends your interest in court – when and where necessary. ​ justclaims.eu’s users are able to track fees, monitor legal spending, reduce overhead, and stay competitive. Take us to the test and request a demo. Ulrich Steppler, LL.M. , is co-founder of the CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH and partner of the law firm ARNECKE SIBETH DABELSTEIN where he co-heads the airline & aviation group out of the Frankfurt office. He specializes in aviation matters with a particular focus on passenger air transportation and has been representing numerous air carriers in Germany, including thousands of passenger claims. Katja H. Brecke, LL.M. (Leiden) , is co-founder of the CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH and partner of the law firm ARNECKE SIBETH DABELSTEIN based in Frankfurt. She has been involved in numerous aviation related matters and has extensive experience in representing passenger airlines and supporting them throughout the claims handling process. With the use of our platform you are not only automating your processes and will reduce cost significantly, but you also can enhance the passengers’ UX, increase customer loyalty, and ticket sales. - Ulrich Steppler, CEO Contact us CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH Güterplatz 1 60327 Frankfurt am Main ​ T +49 69 380 299 910 F +49 69 380 299 911 Imprint Privacy Policy bottom of page

Request a Demo All Posts Suche Eurowings Discover forciert schnelle Streitbeilegung mit justclaims.eu 23. Aug. 2023 2 Min. Lesezeit Die Lufthansa-Tochter Eurowings Discover bietet ihren Kunden nun ein voll automatisiertes Beschwerdemanagement an. Die Software von CHS Claims Handling Solutions ist jetzt freigeschaltet und ermöglicht eine effiziente Streitbeilegung bei etwaigen Unregelmäßigkeiten im Flugbetrieb. Frankfurt, 23. August 2023. Eurowings Discover hat seinen Kundenservice weiter optimiert. Mit einem automatisierten Kundendialog verspricht die Lufthansa-Tochter eine schnelle und einvernehmliche Streitbeilegung im Fall von Verspätungen oder der Annullierung eines Fluges. Das neue Dialog-Formular auf eurowings-discover.com basiert auf der Technik von justclaims.eu, einer Software des Legal-Tech-Anbieters CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH und gilt für alle Abflüge seit dem 1. August dieses Jahres. Die Prüfung individueller Rechtsansprüche der Fluggäste ist in der Software ebenso integriert wie ein effizienter und kundenfreundlicher Dialog. „Das fragwürdige Geschäftsmodell der Claims-Agenturen, welche für ihr Tätigwerden meist hohe Provisionen von den Kunden verlangen, wird durch das neue Angebot endgültig obsolet“, sagt Katja H. Brecke, Geschäftsführerin von CHS Claims Handling Solutions. „Immer mehr Airlines verstehen, dass eine positive Fehlerkultur und transparente Streitbeilegung eine Win-Win-Situation für die Carrier und ihre Kunden darstellen können. Unsere Software wurde mustergültig in die Prozesse von Eurowings Discover integriert“, ergänzt Ulrich Steppler, Co-Geschäftsführer von CHS Claims Handling Solutions. Steppler und Brecke sind auch Partner der Frankfurter Wirtschaftskanzlei Arnecke Sibeth Dabelstein, die CHS Claims Handling Solutions seit 2017 als Spin-off erfolgreich im Airline-Markt etabliert hat. Über Eurowings Discover Eurowings Discover ist die neue Ferienfluggesellschaft der Lufthansa Group, die Reisende von Frankfurt am Main und München zu den schönsten Nah- und Fernreisezielen der Welt fliegt. Durch ein maßgeschneidertes Bordprodukt mit zahlreichen Extras und dem persönlichen Service wird jeder Flug zu einem besonderen Erlebnis. Reisende profitieren von einem durchgängigen Buchungsprozess und nahtlosem Umsteigen an den Drehkreuzen Frankfurt und München sowie an zahlreichen Destinationen der Lufthansa Group und ihren Partner Airlines weltweit. Eurowings Discover ist eine 100-prozentige Tochter der Deutschen Lufthansa AG mit Hauptsitz in Frankfurt. Aktuell betreibt die Fluggesellschaft eine Flotte von 22 Flugzeugen und beschäftigt mehr als 1.700 Mitarbeitende. Die Flüge sind auf eurowings-discover.com, allen Buchungskanälen der Lufthansa Group sowie in Reisebüros buchbar. Über justclaims.eu justclaims.eu ist eine Marke der CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH mit Sitz in Frankfurt. Das Unternehmen ist von 30 Rechtsexperten gegründet und finanziert. justclaims.eu verfolgt einen neuartigen Ansatz bei der Auszahlung von Fluggastansprüchen: Gegründet und gedacht von renommierten Flugrechtexperten ermöglicht justclaims.eu einen effizienten Umgang mit Entschädigungsansprüchen zum gemeinsamen Vorteil von Passagieren und Fluggesellschaften. www.justclaims.eu Medienkontakt Ulrich Steppler und Katja H. Request a Demo All Posts Suche Eurowings Discover pushes fast dispute resolution with justclaims.eu 23. Aug. 2023 2 Min. Lesezeit The Lufthansa subsidiary Eurowings Discover now offers its customers a fully automated complaints management system. The software from CHS Claims Handling Solutions has now been activated and enables efficient dispute resolution in the event of any irregularities in flight operations. Frankfurt, 23 August 2023. Eurowings Discover has further optimised its customer service. With an automated customer dialogue, the Lufthansa subsidiary promises fast and amicable dispute resolution in the event of delays or the cancellation of a flight. The new feedback form on eurowings-discover.com is based on the technology of justclaims.eu, a software of the legal-tech provider CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH and applies to all departures since 1 August this year. The examination of individual legal claims of passengers is integrated in the software as well as an efficient and customer-friendly dialogue. "The questionable business model of the claims agencies, which usually demand high commissions from customers for their activities, is finally rendered obsolete by the new service," says Katja H. Brecke, Managing Director of CHS Claims Handling Solutions. "More and more airlines understand that a positive error culture and transparent dispute resolution can be a win-win situation for carriers and their customers. Our software has been perfectly integrated into the processes of Eurowings Discover," adds Ulrich Steppler, Co-Managing Director of CHS Claims Handling Solutions. Steppler and Brecke are also partners at the Frankfurt-based commercial law firm Arnecke Sibeth Dabelstein, which has successfully established CHS Claims Handling Solutions as a spin-off in the airline market since 2017. About Eurowings Discover Eurowings Discover is the new holiday airline of the Lufthansa Group that flies travellers from Frankfurt am Main and Munich to the most beautiful local and long-haul destinations in the world. A tailor-made on-board product with numerous extras and the personal service make every flight a special experience. Travelers benefit from a consistent booking process and seamless transfers at the hubs in Frankfurt and Munich as well as at numerous destinations of the Lufthansa Group and its partner airlines worldwide. Eurowings Discover is a wholly owned subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG with headquarters in Frankfurt. Currently, the airline operates a fleet of 22 aircraft and employs more than 1,700 people. Flights can be booked on eurowings-discover.com, all booking channels of the Lufthansa Group and in travel agencies. About justclaims.eu justclaims.eu is a brand of CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH based in Frankfurt. März 2023 Lufthansa Group carrier Eurowings Discover optimizes efficiency and increases the speed of its complaint management. The holiday airline now relies on automated support from justclaims.eu in its customer dialogue. The goal is to resolve disputes quickly and amicably without involving an external complaint service provider. Frankfurt, March 22, 2023. Eurowings Discover is going to rely on automated processes of justclaims.eu when handling compensation claims from its customers. The legal-tech solutions of German-based CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH offer airlines decision support in the legal assessment of passenger complaints as well as support through efficient dialogue processes. With the technology from justclaims.eu, the carrier wants to settle any disputes quickly and reliably. The technology is being implemented at Eurowings Discover and should be fully operational in the summer season. "We support airlines and their customers alike and enable efficient and fair dispute resolution," says Ulrich Steppler, Managing Director of CHS Claims Handling Solutions and partner of the renowned commercial law firm Arnecke Sibeth Dabelstein (ASD), spinning off CHS Claims Handling Solutions in 2017 and successfully established it in the airline market. The use of justclaims.eu significantly increases the efficiency of complaint management for Eurowings Discover and other airlines with positive consequences: Customers save themselves the trouble of using an external claims agency and receive the full compensation they are legally entitled to without any commission deducted from any complaints service provider. justclaims.eu also optimizes the airlines' carbon footprint. Katja H. Brecke, partner at ASD and Co-Managing Director explains: "justclaims.eu significantly reduces the volume of e-mails in customer dialogue and thus minimizes CO2 emissions." About Eurowings Discover Eurowings Discover is the new holiday airline of the Lufthansa Group. Travelers benefit from direct connections to all European Lufthansa departure points with an end-to-end booking process and seamless transfers. Eurowings Discover is a wholly owned subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG. About justclaims.eu justclaims.eu is a brand of CHS Claims Handling Solutions GmbH based in Frankfurt.
